market_name: Will 10 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether front-end rate futures (SOFR/Fed funds futures) confirm a dovish repricing or if this is an isolated illiquid Polymarket tick.
time_plan.1h: Compare TLT move to 2y/10y Treasury yield changes; confirm bonds are rallying and it isn't a fluke.
time_plan.2h: Look for a macro catalyst (jobs/CPI shock, bank stress, geopolitical crisis) that would justify emergency-cut pricing; absent one, fade the signal.
time_plan.6h: Reassess whether equity/credit stress accompanies the bond bid (risk-off) versus a benign soft-landing dovish read.
time_plan.12h: Evaluate whether the dovish repricing held into the next session or reversed; log outcome vs prediction.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability of 10 rate cuts (250bps of easing) in 2026 would signal that market participants expect an emergency-scale Fed easing cycle, which typically accompanies a severe recession or financial-crisis shock. That expectation pulls the entire rate path lower and bids long-duration Treasuries. TLT is the most liquid direct duration proxy. Note the 250bps-of-cuts strike is an extreme tail scenario, so the base rate of this market moving meaningfully is low.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Confirm DXY is softening and real yields (TIPS) are falling alongside the dovish signal.
time_plan.1h: Check gold futures volume and whether the move tracks a genuine rate repricing.
time_plan.2h: Identify any risk-off catalyst supporting a haven bid; distinguish rate-driven from crisis-driven move.
time_plan.6h: Reassess dollar and real-yield path; verify gold strength persists.
time_plan.12h: Log whether gold held gains or mean-reverted; compare to prediction.

predictions.reasoning: An aggressive-easing tail scenario implies lower real yields and a weaker dollar, both supportive of gold, plus gold's safe-haven bid if the easing reflects crisis conditions. GLD is a liquid proxy. Magnitude is modest and well below the 700bps tradable threshold; confidence is low because the market is pricing an extreme tail and could simply be noise.

evidence_used: Market question implies 10 cuts = 250bps of easing in a single year, an extreme dovish/emergency scenario
Fed easing cycles of that magnitude historically coincide with recession or crisis and drive lower rates, stronger bonds, weaker USD, and firmer gold
Included emergency-cut clause signals the market accounts for crisis-driven action
uncertainty_notes: Polymarket rate-cut markets are often thinly traded; a probability spike may be noise rather than information
10 cuts is a deep tail; even a large relative probability move can be a small absolute shift
12h window is too short for macro fundamentals to fully play out
Whether the move is 'risk-off crisis' (equities down, bonds up) or 'benign dovish' (equities up) drastically changes equity implications, so equities are left out

llm_justification.summary: A market on 10 Fed rate cuts in 2026 embeds an extreme dovish/emergency-easing scenario. If its implied probability rose sharply, the cleanest downstream reads are lower rates and a crisis-tinged risk backdrop: long Treasuries (TLT) and gold (GLD) rise, dollar softens. Both mappings are modest in magnitude (well under the 700bps tradable bar) and low-confidence because the strike is a deep tail and Polymarket rate markets are noisy sensors.
key_assumptions: A rise in this market reflects genuine expectations of aggressive Fed easing, not liquidity noise
Aggressive-easing pricing lowers the whole rate path, bidding duration and gold
Any easing of this scale is crisis/recession driven rather than benign
failure_modes: The Polymarket move is illiquid noise with no corresponding move in Fed funds futures — proxies don't react
The dovish expectation was already public (post-FOMC, CPI print) and priced into bonds/gold before the market moved
Equities could rally on 'Fed put' optimism, meaning the risk-off interpretation is wrong
If easing is seen as inflationary/currency-debasing, long Treasuries could actually sell off despite cuts
Magnitude far below 700bps threshold — not tradable, only a directional research signal
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
